name: Wellnex Life Limited
summary: Wellnex Life Limited and its subsidiaries develop, market and sell health products across Australia, New Zealand and the UK. Brands include Pain Away topical anti-inflammatories, Wakey Wakey caffeine capsules and multivitamins, Nighty Night sleep aids, Mr. Bright teeth whitening, Wagner Liquigesics pain relief capsules and Wellness Life medicinal cannabis.
